t: This is Leighton House in Holland Park, the home and studio of the Victorian painter Frederic Leighton. He was President of the Royal Academy and is known for the painting Flaming June. Leighton commissioned the architect George Aitchison to build it. Later he added the qa'a, a hall that incorporates tiles and other elements he bought on his travels in the Near East. The house was completed between 1866 and 1895 and is Grade II star listed. It's famous for its elaborate Orientalist interiors, and it's open to the public as a historic house and art museum.
